body.zh: 电流在Wafer上方均匀分布，能量相对均匀
body.en: Current spreads uniformly above the wafer; energy is relatively uniform

body.zh: 典型Wafer Arc形成与演化流程（示例）
电流集中成一条通道，能量高度局部化
body.en: Current concentrates into one channel; energy is highly localized

body.zh: 工程权衡：检测更灵敏：更容易捕捉小Arc，但切换瞬态误报风险也会增加
body.en: Trade-off: more sensitive detection captures small arcs, but increases false alarms from switching transients

body.zh: 量测反馈（多源信号捕捉与交叉验证）
影响晶圆判定、腔体污染、连续损片和潜在可靠性
body.en: Affects wafer disposition, chamber contamination, consecutive wafer loss and latent reliability

body.zh: Wafer Arc、Target Arc与Chamber Arc必须区分，不同平台定义不同
body.en: Distinguish wafer, target and chamber arcs; definitions vary by platform
